survey.surface_gaps: Preserved as nodata; building/bridge coverage gates apply; no interpolation

limitations: Horizontal transform is boundary self-fit, not independent registration.
Vertical floor offset is self-fit to the same returns; it does not establish an ODN floor datum.
2016 proposed geometry and 2022 returns can differ physically.
Canopy-only return counts do not identify a physical canopy or prove an orientation.
Convex envelopes and sparse return coverage do not supply independently surveyed roof corners.
